philosophy: Originate our own lines from official results only; strategies must pass pre-registered validation gates before earning leaderboard rewards. Market comparison gates are BLOCKED because no official odds source exists (flag Q1) — this is disclosed, not worked around.

gates.name: Minimum sample
gates.rule: n >= 300 settled bets or equivalent forecast observations

gates.name: CI excludes zero
gates.rule: 95% Wilson/bootstrap CI for edge must exclude 0 (or 0.5 for rates vs baseline)

gates.name: Walk-forward positive
gates.rule: Out-of-sample (chronological) metrics must beat static-prior and constant baselines
gates.current_note: Elo beats baselines on Brier at n=92 but G1 not met

gates.name: Placebo / leakage test
gates.rule: Permuted-label placebo false-positive rate <= 5%; no future data in features
gates.current_note: leakage design: walk-forward probabilities use only prior games

gates.name: Market comparison
gates.rule: Own line must beat the official closing line / market price
gates.current_note: no official odds source exists (flag Q1); blank by policy

gates.name: Closing line value (CLV)
gates.current_note: no official closing line exists (flag Q1)

strategies.name: Elo value moneyline
strategies.hypothesis: Walk-forward Elo probabilities identify mispriced favorites/underdogs once a market exists to compare against

strategies.name: Rest-advantage moneyline
strategies.hypothesis: Teams with strictly more rest than the opponent win more often than market implies
strategies.metric: Flat paper win rate by rest-diff bucket

current.note: home rest-advantage 10-19 (.526, CI [.317,.727]); equal 22-45; disadvantaged 6-12 — no separation at n=92

strategies.name: Pace-linked same-game legs
strategies.hypothesis: Positive same-game score correlation (SIG-08 r=0.20, p~.05) makes independent leg pricing too cheap for pace-stacked combinations
strategies.metric: Joint frequency vs product of marginals
strategies.status: blocked for pricing — correlation input ready

strategies.name: Cross-game independence parlay
strategies.hypothesis: Same-day game outcomes are approximately independent (supports standard multiplicative parlay pricing)

strategies.name: Trailing-mean prop benchmark
strategies.hypothesis: Player stats versus own trailing mean form a naive benchmark any prop line must beat

strategies.name: Teammate PTS combo legs
strategies.hypothesis: Same-game teammate scoring correlation affects combo pricing

leaderboard.type: internal paper competition (no money, no real wagers)
leaderboard.scoring: Rank = walk-forward forecast skill (Brier improvement vs static prior) × gate progress; rewards unlock only as gates pass
